title: Temperature conversion
description: Switch Calculator to Temperature Converter, convert 100 Celsius to Fahrenheit, and copy the result to the clipboard.
natural_language_instruction: Open the Windows Calculator app, navigate to the Temperature Converter, convert 100 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit, and copy the resulting value (212) to the clipboard using Ctrl+C.

metadata.author: benchmark_team
metadata.notes: Tests Converter mode of the calculator.
